_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: FLAT into the close, verified live by this run. The pre-close slot fired 15:34 ET against its 15:33 window, one minute late and comfortably inside the guard - the first run today to land on its own slot after five consecutive four-minute misses. The scope preflight matched the target account exactly against the connector list and every other account was discarded unread. The broker returns zero option positions, zero equity positions, 109.88 of settled cash and 109.88 of buying power with nothing unsettled. Fifth identical read in a row, and it was taken rather than copied: the rule this slot rests on is that positions come from the broker and never from this file, and a flat read is only worth something if a call was actually made. The balance still comes from the SMR round trip closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET: bought 2 at 0.55 and 0.59 for 114.00, sold at 0.49 for 98.00, -16.00 or -14.0%, settled today. Recorded, not re-graded - grading is the retro's slot.
account.closingNote: THIS IS THE CLOSING READ and the hold decision is the whole of it: THE ACCOUNT GOES INTO THE WEEKEND FLAT, and that is a decision rather than an accident. Written down explicitly because a hold with no entry in the log is an accident that happened to work, and the same is true of a flat book. What was checked, so the absence of an exit is a finding and not a silence: there is no option position, so no expiry no-fly window closes today and none closes before Monday; there is no position of any kind, so no target, no stop and no time stop existed to be enforced, and nothing went unenforced; there is no underlying held into a print tonight, so item 3 never engaged and no straddle was owed. Nothing triggered because there was nothing to trigger on. THE DAY CLOSES WITH NO ENTRY. The 09:33 open slot fired at 11:57, 143 minutes late, and stopped at the staleness guard, so the daily entry mandate is undischarged for 2026-08-07 and no run left today could discharge it - this slot may not open a position in the last thirty minutes, and the mandate binds the open slot alone. That is the cost of the miss stated plainly: the account had 109.88 deployable, the first balance in a week that could afford a contract, and the only slot entitled to use it was too late to be allowed to. Going into a weekend, and into an 8/11 print on the one name here with a catalyst ahead, flat is the position the rulebook would have argued for anyway - but it is being recorded as an outcome that fell out of a missed slot, not as one this board chose on the merits.

entryWatch.setup: Board-wide: the weekend hold is flat, by decision
entryWatch.trigger: Nothing to hold - the book is empty on a live 15:36 read, and this slot may not open a position in the last thirty minutes
entryWatch.why: The first thing a reader should see, and it is the pre-close's actual job rather than a view about any name. Every open position gets decided explicitly at this slot; there are zero, so the decision is that the account goes into the weekend flat and here is the record of it. No option no-fly window closes today because no option is held. No level was hit because no level exists. No earnings hold is being taken tonight because nothing is held into a print. The entry mandate went undischarged today - the 09:33 open fired 143 minutes late and stopped at the staleness guard - and this slot cannot repair that, because the mandate applies to the open and the last thirty minutes are closed to new positions in any case. A run that read an undischarged mandate as licence to buy something at 15:36 would be inventing authority the rulebook withholds, which is a worse failure than the missed slot it would be covering. Nothing below is armed. The names carry live 15:35 bids so the board is accurate into the bell, not so it reads as a shopping list.

entryWatch.trigger: None - the 8/11 print sits inside any five-session hold and no straddle has been pulled
entryWatch.why: The only name on this board with a catalyst still ahead, and the one open item this run hands forward. SMCI is 30.94 bid, +5.3%, easing from 31.22 at 15:22 after firming on every previous read today. It reports 8/11 after the close against a 0.69 estimate, re-verified on the live broker calendar by this run: timing pm, verified true, no actual. A hold opened Monday runs to the print, so the print is inside it, so the at-the-money straddle has to be pulled and the implied move written down before any size is set. No straddle has been pulled. That is stated as an open checklist item rather than guessed at, and the rule it answers to is absolute: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold. The item belongs to Monday's open slot, the last run that sits between this name and the report. Its moves.json spot has been re-read to the live bid by this run, closing the 1.4% drift the 11:57 figure had accumulated.

entryWatch.trigger: Position closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET - nothing to manage, and re-entry is forbidden on the calendar
entryWatch.why: Dead because the position is gone, not because the thesis failed. SMR is 9.75 bid, +3.0%, giving back the 9.88 of 15:22 but still holding above the 9.505 8/5 high the original thesis wanted reclaimed, for a sixth consecutive read. The closed 8/14 9.50 calls were re-quoted live one final time and both sides came off with the underlying: 0.57 bid against a 0.61 ask, where 15:22 read 0.66 and 0.71. The spread is 0.04 and 6.8% of the 0.59 mark, against 7.3% at 15:22, 4.5% at 14:22, 7.2% at 13:23 and 13.9% at 12:24, on 1,016 open interest, 755 traded and delta 0.6064. The percentage tightened while the contract lost 0.095 of mark in fourteen minutes, which is the reading that matters: a spread ratio improving because the mark fell is not liquidity improving, and it is the second time today this board has had to correct a story it was building out of one side of a quote. What refuses a re-entry outright is the calendar, and it refuses absolutely - 8/14 is 7 days out, inside the final week the rulebook bans and far short of the 3-6 week floor. This slot opens nothing in any case.

entryWatch.trigger: Reported 8/7 before the open and gapped - item 2 forbids buying the reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Reported this morning: -0.28 actual against a -0.16 estimate, verified on the live calendar. A miss, and the stock is 48.47 bid and +14.9%, still the best mover on the board but easing off the 49.16 of 15:22 after extending on four straight reads. That combination is exactly what item 2 exists to refuse: this is the reaction day, the gap is already paid for, and +14.9% is far above the top of the range the rule tolerates. Day 2 is Monday and this setup does not carry to it as written. At 48.47 a share it is also 44% of the account in one position, which fails concentration before the tape is argued about.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-07 15:36 ET, live session bids struck by the pre-close run about 24 minutes from the bell. The Last column is the official 8/6 settled close. These are late-session quotes, not closing marks - the official 8/7 closes are not printed yet and this board does not guess at them.
candidatesNote: The account is flat with 109.88 of settled cash, no entry is published or pending, and none will be today. Read the list with that in mind: these are quotes carried so the board is accurate into the bell, not candidates worked up and refused on their merits. No entry was published at the open because that slot fired 143 minutes late and stopped at the staleness guard, and none is published now because the pre-close may not open a position in the last thirty minutes. Breadth is 10 green of 12 for a sixth consecutive read with the same two red - but the direction underneath it finally turned, and that is the one new thing in this read. For five straight reads the leaders extended into the close; in the final fourteen minutes eleven of the twelve names eased or deteriorated. OKLO came off +16.5% to +14.9%, SOUN +14.3% to +13.4%, SMCI +6.3% to +5.3%, SMR +4.3% to +3.0%, while MARA got worse again at -7.2% and AMD slipped to -2.0%. So the fade the whole session refused to give arrived too late to be tradeable by anything, which is the honest way to record it rather than as a signal. Item 2 still calls this list a wait rather than a buy. SMCI on 8/11 after the close is the only catalyst ahead on any of these names; every other 8/4-8/7 print has landed, so no no-fly flags remain from that cluster.

candidates.note: 48.47 bid, +14.9%, still the best mover on the board but easing off 49.16 at 15:22 after four consecutive reads of extending - the first give-back of the session, on a miss of -0.28 against -0.16 verified live this morning. No longer no-fly: the print has landed. Refused on item 2 rather than on the miss, because this is the reaction bar and +14.9% is far above the range the rule tolerates. At 48.47 one share is 44% of the account.

8.03 bid, +13.4%, second-best on the board and easing from 8.09 at 15:22 rather than extending as it had on the four reads before. Well clear of the 8/6 reaction-day damage it was working back through at midday, so the 8/6 refusal was right on the day and is being handed back on day 3, which is the honest way to record it. Still refused today on breadth - a +13.4% session inside a 10-of-12 green board is not the day-2 pullback the rulebook buys.

43.92 bid, +10.6%, essentially flat against the 43.98 of 15:22 and the steadiest of the leaders into the bell. Affordable at 109.88 deployable where it was not at 11.98, so the objection is structural rather than arithmetic: one share is 40% of the account and an -8% stop is 3.51 of room in a name that has travelled several dollars in a session. That is the stop-inside-the-noise problem, and it is what killed the earlier IONQ setup for a different reason.

189.81 bid, +6.6%, the only name on the board to firm into the final quarter hour, a fifth read off the bottom after a six-read run as the worst name here. The 73% beat that sold off for two sessions is still being bought back on day 3. Unreachable regardless - one share is 173% of the account.

17.59 bid, +6.4%, unchanged in character across five reads and holding its level while the leaders faded. Reported 8/6 after the close, so the no-fly flag it carried is spent and it stays on watch. Not held through the print and never proposed into it. Nothing here beyond participation in a green tape.

20.58 bid, +6.1%, easing a shade from 20.65 but holding the reclaim of the 20 line it lost yesterday. It reported 8/6 before the open at -0.13 against a -0.10 estimate - a miss - and is bouncing with the board rather than on anything of its own. A miss is not a catalyst and a sympathy bounce is not a setup.

30.94 bid, +5.3%, easing from 31.22 after firming on all four earlier reads - 30.52, 30.70, 31.13, 31.22. The only name here with a catalyst ahead: 8/11 after the close, 0.69 estimate, re-verified live by this run. Any hold opened Monday contains the print, so item 3 binds and the at-the-money straddle has to be pulled first. It has not been pulled. The item carries to Monday's open, the last slot between this name and the report.

8.58 bid, +4.3%, easing from 8.65 and finishing near the 8.64 of 13:23, still well above the 8.20 line it crossed back and forth four times on 8/6. The line held on the retest and has not been given back in two sessions, which remains the first thing here resembling structure rather than chop. Affordable at 12 shares. Not proposed - this slot opens nothing, and no specification was published at the open either. Worth Monday's open slot looking at first.

30.74 bid, +3.5%, easing from 30.91 but still above both the 30.20 close and the 30.32 pre-earnings line it failed at on 8/6. The structural objection is unchanged and is about 8/5, not today: an open at 34.595 to a 30.20 close on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average gave back the entire earnings move, and one green day does not repair that.

9.75 bid, +3.0%, giving back the 9.88 of 15:22 but holding above the 9.505 8/5 high the original thesis wanted reclaimed for a sixth consecutive read. Not held - the 8/14 9.50 calls were closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET for 0.49. Re-quoted live one last time: 0.57 bid against a 0.61 ask, a 6.8% spread on the 0.59 mark, against 7.3% at 15:22, 4.5% at 14:22, 7.2% at 13:23 and 13.9% at 12:24, on 1,016 open interest, 755 traded and delta 0.6064. Both sides fell with the underlying and the mark lost 0.095 in fourteen minutes, so the ratio improved while the contract got cheaper - which is not liquidity improving, and is the second correction today to a story built out of one side of a quote. The calendar refuses a re-entry regardless and absolutely: 8/14 is 7 days out, inside the banned final week and short of the 3-6 week floor.

479.58 bid, -2.0%, one of the two red names and the only large-cap here, slipping further from 480.31 at 15:22 and still below its close. One share is more than four times the account. Carried for context on breadth, not as a candidate.

9.88 bid, -7.2%, the weakest name on the board and deteriorating on every read since midday, now well below the 10 line it lost this afternoon. Reported 8/6 after the close, so the no-fly flag is spent. Selling off after its print and making new lows into the bell on a day the rest of the board was green is information, and it is the wrong sign for a long.
